scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mammoth/shared build && pnpm --filter @mammoth/backend build && pnpm --filter @mammoth/frontend build
scripts.verify:web: pnpm --filter @mammoth/shared build && pnpm --filter @mammoth/frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter @mammoth/frontend build
scripts.setup: pnpm setup:deps && pnpm setup:db && pnpm build
scripts.setup:db: docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' 'Docker/Colima 没开，Postgres :5433 起不来。先 colima start（或打开 Docker Desktop），再重跑。' >&2; exit 1; } && test -f apps/backend/.env || cp apps/backend/.env.example apps/backend/.env && pnpm db:up && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && pnpm db:deploy && pnpm db:seed
